# Blockula

> Post-quantum blockchain (ML-DSA-65 signatures, BLAKE3) with passkey wallets, .boo names, and an MCP server for agents. Token: FANG (9 decimals).

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): copy-paste prompt, rules, HTTP API
- [README](README.md): quickstart, SDK examples, run your own chain
- [Plan](docs/PLAN.md): architecture, privacy (Ghost Mode), tokenomics, roadmap
- [Mainnet readiness](docs/MAINNET.md): launch blockers, sequence, open decisions
- [Security](SECURITY.md): how to report vulnerabilities

Public testnet: https://blockula-testnet.fly.dev · Wallet: https://blockula-wallet.vercel.app · One-pager: docs/ONE_PAGER.md

## Fastest path
1. `claude mcp add blockula -- npx -y @blockula/mcp` (uses the public testnet automatically)
2. MCP: create_wallet → faucet → register_name / send (start_dev_node for a local chain, needs the node binary)
3. App code: `import { Wallet, Client } from "@blockula/sdk"`; browser users: `import { createPasskeyWallet } from "@blockula/sdk/passkey"`
4. Contribute: MCP list_hunts → implement → PR merges → submit_contribution (contribution pool, judged by Séance juries; see AGENTS.md)
